resources.string: Your music, with a personal touch.
Disabled. You can still try the preview.
Enabled. Set up access to start automatically.
Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Tidal, Deezer, Amazon Music, Bitchord, Namida and Musicolet.
Allow access to show the track and playback controls.
Access granted. Ready to read the music session.
Double tap to show the controls, and again to dim them. They also dim automatically after 10 seconds.
Double tap to show the controls, then swipe up or tap the upward arrow. Complete Android’s authentication when prompted.
The palette and light or dark theme follow your system settings.
The player appears above the lock screen while music is playing. The display stays on, so it may use more battery than the system AOD.
Double tap to switch modes · Go back to close
Access settings are unavailable on this device.
Allow the player to appear automatically while listening in a supported music app.
Permission granted. Android still handles unlocking.
Enabled. Allow display over other apps to start automatically.
Ready. Appears on the lock screen while you listen in a supported music app.
This control is unavailable for this track.
Keeps the player illuminated while music is playing and your phone is connected to your car’s Bluetooth device.
Only activates when the phone is connected to a power source.
Enable the player to use driving mode.
Choose a device to finish setup.
Allow Nearby devices access to recognize your car’s Bluetooth connection.
Bluetooth access denied. Driving mode stays inactive.
You can allow Nearby devices access in GlanceBeat’s app permissions.
Bluetooth is unavailable on this device.
Bluetooth is off. Your selection is saved.
The selected device is no longer paired. Choose another one.
Waiting for a connection to your car.
Car connected. Activates when you play music.
Car connected. The player stays illuminated on the lock screen.
Choose an already paired device. Driving mode will follow its connection.
No paired devices. Pair your car in Bluetooth settings, then come back here.
Double tap can always dim the player. The normal timeout returns when the car disconnects.

Keeps the player visible during brief interruptions from other apps, only while the phone is locked and music is playing. It does not read screen contents, intercept keys or perform gestures in other apps. Android still handles unlocking.
Optional: uses Android accessibility to cover interruptions from other apps.
When the Fold is open, interactive mode shows the queue and player in two columns. Ambient mode shows only the player, centered.
Player on the left, queue on the right

Music player active. Swipe across the artwork to change tracks. Double tap to dim. Swipe up or tap the upward arrow to request Android’s unlock screen.
Music player dimmed. Double tap for controls.
Music player: tap to return to the controls

No app is available to open this link.
Two permissions to bring your music to the lock screen.
Used to detect the track and controls from your music app and show notification icons. Enable GlanceBeat in Android settings, then come back here.
Allows the player to appear automatically above the lock screen while music is playing. Grant this permission to GlanceBeat, then come back here.
Continuity and Bluetooth are optional. You can configure them in settings to cover interruptions or use driving mode.
If Android blocks this access, open GlanceBeat’s App info and look for “Allow restricted settings” in the menu, then come back here.
